text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That was every bit the challenge I<n>expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But victory is mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That said, since the Triple Crown<n>slipped through
my fingers, I will need<n>another mark of rule to
replace it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. A grand and storied race<n>upon which to
make my mark: the<n>spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
3,200 meters is a grueling distance,<n>but it presents
the perfect opportunity<n>to demonstrate my prowess
as a<n>stayer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And victory in the Tenno Sho grants a<n>particular
prestige.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us honor the suffering and<n>perseverance of our
forebears with a<n>stunning victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now more than ever, I must deliver a<n>performance
worthy of the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so we set our sights on the<n>spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: We return to the waiting room to find...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You raced well today, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove. Have you been<n>waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Only to pass on my congratulations.<n>Now that that's
done, I ought to head<n>back home.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is it my imagination, or do you look a<n>little under the
weather?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your complexion strikes me as<n>somewhat pale. As
though you've<n>been missing sleep... or perhaps
meals.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Apologies. My student council duties<n>have been
taking up a lot of my time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's not like you to let them get out of<n>hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This year's New Year's party has<n>required more
paperwork than usual,<n>and attending to it has been
somewhat time-consuming.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From what I can gather, it sounds like<n>Air Groove
has been in charge of<n>organizing the New Year's
party that<n>the student council runs.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't you say something? Let<n>me take
charge of this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize. For all<n>the virtue of
hard work, you have<n>been pushing yourself too
much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You may be exceptional, but even you<n>have your
limits, especially in this<n>busy season. Surely you
can lean on<n>me once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, I ought to attend to student<n>council business.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fortuitously enough, my last great<n>task of the year
has just concluded.<n>Excellent timing, if I do say so
myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have a request for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Take care of Air Groove. See that she<n>gets some
rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And could you pick out something for<n>us to eat
while I finish things up here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, there's no need for that. I can do<n>it myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Between your fatigue-addled mind<n>and my
trainer's ample experience,<n>which would you say is
the more<n>suitable candidate?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Point taken.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then my request stands. Trainer, if<n>you would.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a light snack, Symboli Rudolf<n>and Air Groove
head back to the<n>academy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The New Year's party ends up a<n>great success,
and is very much<n>appreciated by the Umamusume
staying at school over the holidays.
